'''Renlo Waimet''' was a [[human]] who served the [[partisans]] of resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]] as part of the [[Security guard|security detail]] at their [[Saw Gerrera's Base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Segra Milo]]. In [[5 BBY]], he patted down the rebel [[Luthen Rael]] when Rael visited the base.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Stop! Right there. Search him.|Benthic has Renlo Waimet search Luthen Rael|translated=1|audio=SearchHim-Benthic-DaughterOfFerrix.flac|<ref name="Daughter">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>}}
[[File:RenloLuthen-DaughterOfFerrix.png|thumb|right|300px|Renlo Waimet searched Luthen Rael on Segra Milo.]]
Renlo Waimet was a [[human]] member of resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]] during the group's [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|campaigns]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. He served as part of the [[Security guard|security detail]] for Gerrera's [[starfighter]] [[Saw Gerrera's Base|launch base]] on the [[planet]] [[Segra Milo]].<ref name="Dawn" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|111}}</ref> Waimet stood with fellow partisan [[Benthic]] and another human member of the group at an entrance to<ref name="Daughter" /> the hidden valley<ref name="Daughter AD">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> where the base was located. When Gerrera's ally [[Luthen Rael]] approached the valley entrance, Benthic had him stop and ordered Waimet to search Rael.<ref name="Daughter" />

As Waimet patted Rael down, Benthic explained to the newcomer that Gerrera was in a bad mood. Waimet then discovered Rael's [[Luthen Rael's walking stick|collapsed walking stick]] and took it, inspecting the device. Rael told Waimet to either return the device to him or put it down, causing the partisan to stare quizzically, but Benthic interrupted the search as Gerrera was waiting. Grabbing back the [[Cane|stick]], Rael then followed Benthic further into the base, leaving Waimet and the other human partisan at the valley entrance.<ref name="Daughter" />

==Personality and traits==
Waimet had an understandable mistrust of outsiders and believed that Gerrera should have nothing to do with the wider [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|rebellion]] against the Empire. He had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and shaved, black [[hair]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Equipment==
While at the Segra Milo base, Waimet wore a sleeveless, green [[jacket]] with brown fingerless [[glove]]s, [[Clothing|pants]], and [[boot]]s. He carried a [[blaster rifle]] with a shoulder-sling.<ref name="Daughter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Renlo Waimet was portrayed by [[Leonardo Taiwo]] in the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], with the character being credited only as "partisan."<ref name="Daughter" /> This credit for Taiwo first appeared in the eighth episode, "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Episode 8">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> which aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]];<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> however, Waimet is not clearly visible anywhere in that episode.<ref name="Episode 8" /> The character then appeared on screen in the eleventh episode, "[[Daughter of Ferrix]],"<ref name="Daughter" /> which aired on [[November 16]], 2022.<ref name="Release dates" /> Taiwo's scene in the episode was photographed at the [[Wikipedia:Winspit|Winspit Quarry]], [[Wikipedia:Worth Matravers|Worth Matravers]] in [[Wikipedia:Dorset|Dorset]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Location">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e11-trivia-gallery|text="Daughter of Ferrix" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref> The character's name was then revealed in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="Dawn" /> within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="DawnAuthor">{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}}</ref>
